name: day-trader-skill-india
description: The Day Trader skill pack for Claude, ported to the Indian stock market (NSE)

plugins.name: day-trader-skill-india
plugins.description: Eleven Claude skills for day trading NSE stocks: a chart scanner, a news and filings monitor, an entry timer, an exit planner, a time machine that replays 10,000 sessions, a risk manager, a budget manager, an order ticket you enter yourself in your broker app, price alerts, an earnings analyst and an insider and big-deals tracker. Rupees, IST and NSE hours. Nothing places an order for you.
